feeding_claim.verbatim: Born in grass, raised on grass, finished on grass.

notes: Scout 2026-11-28: lead was filed under MS but the farm is in North Carolina. Read beamfamilyfarms.com Products, Our Farm, Contact and Ella's Pastured Pork pages through WebFetch summaries; the homepage fetch and the Barn2Door store fetch were blocked, so no pickup, delivery or shipping details and no phone were found. The site says Delight, NC (about 30 miles north of Shelby) while the Contact page address is Lawndale, NC; listed Lawndale from the address. Beef described as 100% grass-fed, grass-finished and grain-free for life; pork is pasture raised with a complete diet (pastured, not grass-only); veal is described as free-range. Shares: half, quarter and eighth cow, whole and half hogs. Recheck the Barn2Door store for fulfillment options.
